About.description: The node type, for the icon's hover and the hover card.

path.description: Where it sits in the palette (`A › B`).

Anim.description:
The run animation's switches. The fill a face takes from `shown` (and its pulse and fade)
is the shell's to compute per frame (section 8.6); the core never publishes per frame.

on.description: Faces are washed with their run state (View › Colour Nodes While Running, or a replay).

disabled.description: Why it can't be picked here.

CommandRun.description: What a gesture ran: one per command, in order.

Delta.description:
What `scene.get {since}` returns when it isn't everything (section 8.12): the items whose
revision is past `since`, the ids gone since, and the parts that come every time.

rect.description: A marquee's rect, and the faces it touches.

at.description: The tag's offset from its pin.

text.description:
What the driver's tag says: the net's name and how many inputs it feeds ("picture ×3",
as the egui editor's tag; N4 slice 3). The hit test's estimate of the tag is this text's.

Face.description: A node's face: a node, or a collapsed group's node (`proxy`).

id.description: The node's id; a collapsed group's is `group:<id>`.

kind.description: The node type ("" for a proxy).

menu.description: The context menu to fetch with `menu.get` (`node` or `proxy`).

nid.description: Stable for the document's life, never reused (hot calls use it).

rev.description: The scene generation at which this face last changed.

shown.description:
The run animation's state for the face (`waiting`, `running`, `done`, `cached`,
`failed`, `skipped`); a proxy shows its members' busiest.

watched.description: The Watched panel shows it (the border is 1.5 wider).

FaceReport.description: One face's measurements in `geometry.set` (graph units, at zoom 1).

node.description: The face's id (a node's; `group:<id>` for a collapsed group's).

offset.description: Where the face's top left is drawn, from its position (default `[0, 0]`).

parts.description: The header's parts and the footer's items, face coordinates.

pins.description: Each pin's height from the face's top, in row order; null: not measured.

rev.description: The face's `rev` measured; absent: not said.

rows.description: Each input row's widget rect `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` in face coordinates; null: none.

Fit.description:
A fit the core asks for: the shell fits `rect` (graph units) into its view, zoom at most 1
(and at least 0.2), and animates there. `seq` rises with every request, so a shell fits once
a request however often the scene comes.

rect.description:
`[x0, y0, x1, y1]`: every face shown, and the frames outside an entered group, with a
margin of 32.

Focus.description: The group entered, and the breadcrumb to it (outermost first).

Footer.description: A footer item, in the order drawn (section 8.7).

oneOf.description: A Convert node's path, a line each.
Save Result… (and Contact Sheet… with `sheet`): `run.save {node, port, sheet, ask: true}`.
The text the node made, a few lines: a tap watches it.

stale.description: Faces measured at an older `rev` than the scene's: kept, and to measure again.

unknown.description: Faces the graph doesn't have (at most 64), skipped.

Gesture.description: `ui.gesture`'s params: a recognised gesture in graph units.

at.description: `[x, y]`, within ±1e7 (a drag's cancel needs none).

zoom.description:
The view's zoom, screen points a graph unit (default 1, held to 0.01 to 100): a scrub's
speed (N4 slice 2, contract 8.13). The core took it before the schema said so (found by
the Windows kit, the N4 device gate).

oneOf.description: A secondary click, a Control-click, a long press (`longPress` is taken too).

cancelled.description: A drag's cancel: was one under way.

context.description: A context gesture's: `menu.get`'s `context` for what it was on, and the menu.

drag.description:
A drag's: `{serial, kind: move | wire | marquee | bend | frame | resize | group, faces?
(a move's, nids), from? (a wire's fixed end), picked? (an input whose wire's end was
picked up)}`.

Group.description:
A group. A collapsed one is drawn as its proxy face; an open one as a frame around its
members, whose rect needs measured geometry (slice 3).

proxy.description: Its proxy face is drawn (the outermost collapsed group, visible).

rect.description:
An open group's frame, `[x0, y0, x1, y1]`, the header band its top
[`crate::geometry::GROUP_HEADER`] ([`crate::geometry::open_group_rects`]); none when
collapsed, entered, or none of its faces is shown. N2 slice 3.

about.description: What the icon's hover says of the node type.

open.description: The node is open (not `collapsed`); a proxy's chevron expands its group.

Hit.description:
What is at a point, as the JSON queries give it (`geometry.hit`, `geometry.wireTarget`, a
gesture's `hit` and a wire's `target`); `plum_hit` is its typed form.

at.description: A pin's point (where a wire snaps), else the point asked.

index.description: A row, footer item or bend point.

nid.description: The nid of what was hit.

part.description:
A node's part (`body`, `header`, `title`, `chevron`, `icon`, `menu`, `enter`, `row`,
`preview`, `footer`), a tag's (`driver`, `use`), a frame's (`body`, `tab`, `handle`), a
group's (`band`).

side.description:
A pin's side (`in`, `out`), index, type, and whether a wire fits it (0, 1, 2 through a
Convert).

badge.description: `wired` over a bundled value: the badge whose button resets it (`bundle.reset`).

dim.description: The caption is dim: the value is the default.

editor.description:
The value its node names an editor for (`NodeDef.editor`), not on a wire: a tap on the
row opens it, `node.editor {node}` (the row's `node`: on a collapsed group's face, the
member's; FR1), as the node's own footer does. Absent for every other row.

inactive.description: Not read with the node's current values (`Port::active_when`).

label.description: The label as drawn (`[ ]` after it for a list).

named.description: A named port's tag before the caption.

node.description: The node whose port it is: the face's own, or on a proxy the member it stands for.

text.description:
The row's words where it has no widget: `label = value (wired from Title)`, the typed
label, the bundle's value, `label: value`.

Mark.description: An application's mark on a wire (`Hooks::wire_marks`).

at.description: Where it is drawn: its wire's middle (none when its wire isn't drawn). N2 slice 3.

id.description: The wire it marks (`node.port` of its input).

NameEdit.description: The name being edited: the scene's `view.name`.

hint.description: Shown greyed in an empty field (a node's type name).

label.description: What is being named, for the field's accessibility label ("Frame title").

rect.description:
Where the field goes, graph units `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` (the shell keeps it at least legible,
as a row's editor).

oneOf.description: A node's title (`node.title`; blank goes back to its type's name).

An input made one of the graph's parameters (`graph.port.name`), or a named port's name
(`graph.port.rename`).
A wire's slice (`wire.slice`; blank clears it).
Every wire from an output drawn through one net (`output.label`).

Net.description: A net drawn through labels: its driving tag at the output, a receiving tag at each input.

id.description: `name`, or `name@group` for a net local to a group.

NetKeySchema.description: A net's key: its name, and the group it is local to (absent: the top level).

label.description: The label as drawn (typed, `[ ]` before it for a list).

node.description: The node whose output it is (on a proxy, the member's).

Paint.description:
A colour: a theme token by name, or `[r, g, b, a]` where there is none (computed: a family's
tint, an engine's wire-type colour, a frame's own). Exactly one of the two is sent
(`docs/shell-interface.md` question 13, decided 13A; built in N2 slice 4): a shell resolves a
token with `theme.get`, so a theme change changes only the faces whose computed colours change.

color.description: `[r, g, b, a]`, premultiplied; none when `token` names it.

Palette.description:
The node palette as the core keeps it (N3 slice 1): where a node picked goes, what was typed,
and the wire it was opened for, when a new wire was dropped on empty canvas (question 8).

at.description: Where a node picked is added (graph units), or none: the view's centre, the shell's.

wire.description:
The wire dropped: only kinds that take it are offered (`palette.items`), and the one
picked is added with it connected (`palette.choose`, one undo step).

PaletteWire.description:
The end of a dropped wire that stays: the output it leaves (`from`; a new node's input takes
it), or the input it enters (`to`; a new node's output feeds it). Exactly one is given.

Picked.description: The selection, as the scene carries it.

Pin.description: A pin: round for scalars, square otherwise; a port that can't be wired has a hidden pin.

wire.description: The colour of a wire drawn from it.

PopoutWindow.description:
One pop-out window: what it follows, and enough for a shell to title it, bring it forward and
know when to read its value again.

raised.description: Rises each time the pop-out is asked for while open: the shell brings its window forward.

stamp.description:
Changes when what `popout.get` reads changes (the value a run sent, the viewer's state):
the shell reads it again then.

title.description: The window's title: the node's title and the port.

viewer.description:
The viewer it shows: the one asked for, else the value's default (`values::default_viewer`);
none until a run has sent the value.

oneOf.description:
A picture, by its value reference (`media.get`). `items` above 1: the value is a list (of
named pictures, when the engine names them) and this is one of them, `caption` its name.
Fields may be added: outside this crate a pattern ends with `..` (the core builds it).

caption.description: The picture's own name (the rendition's `caption`), when the engine gives one.

levels.description:
A nested list's counts a level at a time, outermost first (`[3, 2]`: 3 runs of 2; the
face says "3 × 2"); empty when the list isn't nested (spec 7.6 rule 2).

Reveal.description: Reveal `node`, whose face is at `rect` (graph units), once per `seq`.

RowEdit.description: The row a field editor is open on (`row.edit`; the scene's `view.edit`).

face.description: The face that shows it, and the row's index in that face's `inputs`.

node.description: The node whose input it is (a collapsed group's row: the member's).

RowEditor.description:
What a row whose value has an editor says of it (section 8.4): the application's editor's
label and help where it registered one for the kind, else the command's own words.

RunShown.description: The node's real run state (section 8.6's first layer).

Scene.description: The whole scene, or (from [`Published::get`] with `since`) what changed.

view.description: What the core asks the shell's view to show (N2 slice 3).

Spot.description:
The header's state mark: `spinner` while running, `dot` in the state's colour, `none`
before any run (the slot is kept).

Status.description: A piece of the header's status slot (at least 88 wide).

ThemeReply.description: `theme.get`'s reply: every token a scene may name.

tokens.description: `[r, g, b, a]`, premultiplied, by token name.

watch.description: A tap watches the node's first output (it has outputs), a double tap opens its parameters.

View.description:
What the core asks the shell's view to show (`docs/shell-interface.md` 8.9's view domain, as
far as N2 slice 3 builds it): the latest fit.

edit.description:
The row a field editor is open on (`row.edit`, N4 slice 2): the shell puts its native
control over it. Left out while none is.

fit.description: The latest fit asked for (`canvas.fit`), or none since the document opened.

name.description:
A name being edited in place (`name.edit`, N4 slice 3): the shell puts a text field over
`rect`. Left out while none is.

palette.description:
The node palette, while it is open (`canvas.palette`; core state since N3 slice 1, open
question 4). Left out while it is closed.

reveal.description:
The latest node asked to be revealed (`canvas.reveal`, N4 slice 3: core view state, as
`fit` is): the shell centres its view on `rect` once per `seq`. Left out until one is.

select.description:
Select mode is on (`canvas.selectMode`, N4 slice 3): a one-finger drag on empty canvas
draws a marquee rather than panning, on a shell recognising touch. Left out while off.

windows.description:
The document's windows (contract 12.5's `windows` domain, carried in the scene's view
since N4 slice 3): the parameters inspector and the pop-outs. Left out while none is open.

zoom.description:
The latest zoom asked for (`canvas.zoom`, N5 slice 3: Zoom In, Zoom Out and Actual Size
are commands, the view itself the shell's): the shell zooms its view by `by`, or to `to`,
about the view's centre, once per `seq`. Left out until one is.

Widget.description: A widget: what it shows and what bounds it. Every widget commits one `node.set` (8.5).

blank.description: The value is JSON null (shown as `blank`).

clearable.description: The default is null and the value not: a `×` sets null.

text.description:
A number as every shell shows it (N4 slice 4: an INT whole, a FLOAT at `decimals`;
[`widget_text::number_text`]): on the face, in the inspector and while scrubbing.

Windows.description: The document's windows, in the scene's `view.windows`.

cache.description: The Cache Report is open (`run.cacheReport`, N4 slice 6): `report.get {window: "cache"}`.

editors.description:
The nodes whose value editor is open (`node.editor`, N4 slice 6), oldest first:
`report.get {window: "editor", node}`.

messages.description:
The Messages window is open (`view.messages`, N4 slice 5): a native shell shows the
status bar's messages in full (`messages.get`) in a window or sheet of its own, and closes it
with `view.messages {open: false}`.

parameters.description: The node the parameters inspector is open on.

params.description:
The graph's Parameters window is open (`view.params`, N4 slice 6):
`report.get {window: "params"}`.

reports.description:
Changes when what a report window reads changes (a run reported, the named ports, a
value): the shell reads its open reports again then.

settings.description:
The Settings window is open, on this section (`app.settings {tab?, open?}`, N4 slice 4):
a native shell shows its own settings window or sheet while it is, and closes it with
`app.settings {open: false}`.

Wire.description: A wire, keyed by the input it feeds (one wire an input).

fromFace.description: The faces and pins it is drawn between (a collapsed group's node stands for its members).

path.description:
Its path as a cubic chain, graph units: the start, then two control points and the end a
segment ([`crate::wire_path`]); every shell draws this curve and the core hit-tests it.
Empty for a wire drawn through a net (its tags are drawn). N2 slice 3.

WireTargetQuery.description: `geometry.wireTarget`'s params: where a wire dragged from `from` may land.

Zoom.description:
Zoom the view by `by` (Zoom In 1.25, Zoom Out 0.8) or to `to` (Actual Size 1), about its
centre, once per `seq` (`canvas.zoom`, N5 slice 3).

description: The editor core <-> shell interface (docs/shell-interface.md): scene.get's reply (Scene, or Delta with since), geometry.set (GeometrySet, GeometrySetReply), ui.gesture (Gesture, GestureReply), geometry.hit (HitQuery), geometry.wireTarget (WireTargetQuery), their replies (Hit), geometry.locate (LocateReply), theme.get (ThemeReply). Readers skip unknown fields and kinds.
title: PlumCraft shell interface 1
